FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about receiving, holding, and sending money with Clap on WhatsApp.

q1.question: What is Clap?
q1.answer: Clap is a WhatsApp-based financial platform that lets individuals and businesses receive international payments, hold multiple currencies, exchange funds, and send money across borders—all without leaving WhatsApp.

q2.question: Do I need to download a separate app?
q2.answer: No. Clap runs entirely within WhatsApp, so there's nothing extra to download to get started. A dedicated mobile app is also coming soon for users who want it.

q3.question: Which currencies can I hold and exchange?
q3.answer: Clap lets you hold multiple currencies in one place and convert between them at competitive rates, so you can receive and send funds internationally without juggling separate accounts.

q4.question: Is Clap a bank?
q4.answer: No. Clap is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking, payment processing, and foreign exchange services are provided through licensed, regulated third-party financial institution partners.

q5.question: When can I start using Clap?
q5.answer: Clap is currently in early access. Join the waitlist and we'll notify you as soon as your account is ready to activate.
